first_error_evidence: Agent uses wc -l on a multiline CSV (step 3), treating physical line count as record count; also in steps 6-7, agent pipes a single physical line via sed to csv.reader, which cannot parse a record spanning multiple physical lines.
verification_evidence: Step 13 runs transform_final.py and inspects printed output rows; steps 17-18 create and run a dedicated validation script that asserts header correctness and per-row constraints, reporting 'All rows validated successfully.'
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent explored the CSV structure via shell tools, hit dead ends with sed-based line parsing, then pivoted to a proper csv.reader-based Python script that correctly extracted postal_code/city from multiline addresses, reformatted birth_date, constructed team_name, and validated the output.
